entities.name: Master of the Life of the Virgin

entities.summary: The Master of the Life of the Virgin, in German the Meister des Marienlebens,, is the pseudonym given to a Northern renaissance German painter working in Cologne. He can also be known as the Master of Wilten, or Johann van Duyren, an identification not universally accepted.
